Downtown Albuquerque.name: Downtown Albuquerque
Downtown Albuquerque.description: Civic and rail-runner core around Central and 2nd with office-to-residential conversions and the densest issued-permit volume.

Old Town.name: Old Town
Old Town.description: Plaza-centered historic adobe stock with renovation-heavy permitting and preservation overlays west of downtown.

Barelas.name: Barelas
Barelas.description: South-of-downtown rail and warehouse district with adaptive reuse along 4th Street and the Barelas-South Valley seam.

Nob Hill.name: Nob Hill
Nob Hill.description: Route 66 commercial spine east of downtown with storefront renovation, ADU pressure, and the metro's densest street-retail permits.

UNM / University.name: UNM / University
UNM / University.description: Campus-adjacent rental and medical-office stock with student-housing infill and hospital-corridor permitting.

International District.name: International District
International District.description: Central-east corridor along Zuni and Central with small-lot commercial rehab and high 311-to-permit imbalance.

Uptown.name: Uptown
Uptown.description: Louisiana and I-40 office-retail node with mixed-use tower conversions and the Heights' densest commercial permit pipeline.

Far Northeast Heights.name: Far Northeast Heights
Far Northeast Heights.description: Post-war tract grid toward the Sandias with teardown/rebuild and ADU permitting on large lots.

Foothills.name: Foothills
Foothills.description: High-value east-edge estate stock under Open Space constraints, dominated by renovation rather than new construction.

North Valley.name: North Valley
North Valley.description: Acequia-irrigated lots along 4th Street with estate infill, horse-property splits, and Los Ranchos-adjacent permitting.

Journal Center.name: Journal Center
Journal Center.description: I-25 north employment campus with office, industrial, and limited residential conversion permits.

Alameda.name: Alameda
Alameda.description: Northern city-limit villages along the Rio Grande with sparse permitting and agricultural-lot pressure.

West Central / Atrisco.name: West Central / Atrisco
West Central / Atrisco.description: Central Avenue west of the river with corridor commercial rehab and Atrisco-grant residential infill.

Taylor Ranch / Petroglyph.name: Taylor Ranch / Petroglyph
Taylor Ranch / Petroglyph.description: Northwest mesa master-planned tracts against Petroglyph National Monument with high single-family permit velocity.

Volcano Cliffs.name: Volcano Cliffs
Volcano Cliffs.description: Far-west escarpment growth edge with new-construction permitting on volcanic-mesa lots.

South Valley.name: South Valley
South Valley.description: Unincorporated-adjacent south valley with agricultural-lot splits, owner-builder permits, and Isleta-road commercial.

Sunport / Airport.name: Sunport / Airport
Sunport / Airport.description: Airport and Yale industrial belt with warehouse, hotel, and limited residential permitting south of Gibson.

Mesa del Sol.name: Mesa del Sol
Mesa del Sol.description: Master-planned south mesa with the city's largest greenfield residential and employment-center pipeline.
